title: 第9章 兰清雅负荆请罪，元天至尊秘藏
content_zh:
兰清雅懵了，完全懵了。
她捂着自己的火辣辣的侧脸，一脸不可置信地看着君仗剑。
君仗剑脸色阴沉无比，眸中涌动着冷意。
“仗剑公子，你打我？”兰清雅无法置信的开口。
感觉着那逐渐肿起的脸颊，兰清雅觉得自己好像在做梦一般。
君仗剑，不是一直对她百依百顺吗？
甚至让兰清雅有一种，君家序列不过如此的感觉。
兰清雅甚至幻想，自己以后，可以完全掌控君仗剑，自己说什么，他都会去做。
试问哪个外姓家臣，能够掌控君家序列？
她兰清雅能！
但是现在，看着君仗剑那阴沉如水的脸色，兰清雅感觉他像是变成了一个陌生人。
“谁让你去招惹君逍遥的？”君仗剑语气压抑着怒火。
“我……我都是为了仗剑公子您着想啊，您之前招揽君玲珑，被她无视，结果她却愿意追随那君逍遥……”兰清雅依然在辩解。
“混账！”
君仗剑闻言，忍不住再度一巴掌扇向兰清雅另外半张脸。
兰清雅直接是被扇飞，嘴角都破了，流血不止。
“你知道君逍遥是什么身份吗，知道他的父亲是谁吗？”君仗剑真是气得肝疼。
这兰清雅，是嫌他的序列地位太稳了，想要动摇吗？
“不就是那君无悔吗，如今下落都是不明！”兰清雅咬着银牙，脸色难看。
“你没资格侮辱无悔族叔！”

君仗剑啪啪啪，连续扇了兰清雅十几个耳光，将其脸颊都是扇成了猪头。
周围所有追随者皆是一脸错愕之色。
这太阳是打西边出来了？
“别说君逍遥是无悔族叔的儿子，他的母亲，也是姜家神女，他还得到了十八祖的重视，你招惹他，是想让我丢掉第十序列的位置吗？”君仗剑真恨不得扇死兰清雅。
招惹谁不好，偏偏招惹了君家地位最高，背景最大的君逍遥。
“仗剑公子，清雅错了，饶了清雅吧！”
兰清雅跪地磕头，满下巴都是血。
她千算万算，都没想到君仗剑会这么忌惮君逍遥，甚至不惜对她动手。
“起来，去向君逍遥负荆请罪！”君仗剑冷漠道。
“仗剑公子，这……”兰清雅如遭雷击。
若真如此，她以后还如何有脸在君家待下去？
而且要她当着君玲珑低头认错，简直比吃屎还要难受。
“嗯？不去？”君仗剑眸光如剑一般凌厉。
“我去……”兰清雅心头惶恐，一脸屈辱之色。
随后，一位追随者找来一捆荆条，让兰清雅背着。
荆条上锋利的棘刺划破了她的玉背，让兰清雅痛的嘶嘶吸凉气。
“算了，我和你一起去吧，这样才显得有诚意。”君仗剑略一迟疑，决定自己也一同前去。
兰清雅更是心中绝望。
她是第一次看到君仗剑这样忐忑不安。
那君逍遥，究竟是何方神圣，能让君仗剑忌惮到这种程度？

君仗剑带着负荆请罪的兰清雅，离开了灵岛，前往天帝宫。
一路上，很多君家子弟都是注意到了。
“那是……第十序列君仗剑，他出关了？”
“君仗剑的实力又有进步，而且是前往天帝宫方向，难道是去找神子的麻烦？”
“不对，你们看那兰清雅……”
诸多目光，落在兰清雅身上。
她负荆请罪，玉背一片血痕，双颊红肿，嘴角破裂流血，看上去要多狼狈有多狼狈。
“难道君仗剑不是去找场子，而是去……赔罪？”
所有君家子弟，都是感觉一阵愕然。
堂堂君家第十序列，居然直接服软了？
“啧啧，恐怕只有神子大人，才有资格让一位序列，不战而屈人之兵。”一位君家年轻人赞叹道。
十大序列，哪一个不是满身傲气？
想要不战而屈人之兵，太难了。
但君逍遥，却是办到了。
天帝宫内，君逍遥在放松心神。
一旁君玲珑则在为君逍遥泡茶。
以万年凝露为水，搭配从悟道古树上摘下的茶叶。
这一壶茶，放在外界，一些普通天骄一辈子都享受不到。
君逍遥却是每天都在喝。
“公子，请……”君玲珑递上茶水，一副尽职尽责的侍女模样。

这时，一位天帝宫仆从在门口恭敬喊道：“神子大人，君仗剑公子前来天帝宫了。”
“终于来了吗，害我等了这么多天。”君逍遥眸光一亮，来了精神。
终于开始王道剧情了吗。
兰清雅回去哭诉，君仗剑无脑暴怒，然后决定前来教训教训他。
君逍遥也刚好需要一个人，来检测他的神象镇狱劲。
君玲珑俏脸倒也镇定，她知道，君仗剑应该奈何不了君逍遥。
“呵呵，逍遥族弟，自你出生到现在，这还是第一次见面，没想到却是以这样的方式，着实有些可惜。”
一道爽朗的声音传来，君仗剑踏门而入，身旁跟着狼狈的兰清雅，她低着头，背上背着荆条。
“咦，这……不对啊……”君逍遥见状，心里疑惑道。
他感觉君仗剑不按套路出牌。
“我麾下的追随者，招惹了逍遥族弟，特意让她前来负荆请罪，希望逍遥族弟大人有大量。”君仗剑淡淡笑道。
兰清雅咬着牙，无比屈辱，但还是跪在了地上。
从嘴巴缝里挤出一句话道：“希望神子大人，还有君玲珑，能够饶恕清雅……”
说完这句话，兰清雅简直想把头埋进地里。
君玲珑俏脸冷淡。
君逍遥亦是沉吟不语。
君仗剑见状，眼角一抽。
他真的怕君逍遥告状十八祖，那他的序列前途可就全毁了。
暗暗一咬牙，君仗剑拿出一块令牌道：“对了，我之前在外历练，意外得到了两块元天至尊令，传闻可能同元天至尊的秘藏有关，多一块我也无用，就送给逍遥族弟了。”
“至尊秘藏！”一旁君玲珑美目也是暗暗震动。

圣境之上，便是至尊之境。
那可是真正踏立在仙域巅峰的存在，不朽不灭，威慑万古时空！
这样一位至尊的秘藏，价值无法想象！
这种令牌放到外界，会掀起一番血雨腥风，引无数天骄拼死争夺！
君仗剑也是费了好一番功夫，付出了许多代价，才得到两块的。
君逍遥也是诧异，没想到君仗剑竟然舍得拿出这种好东西。
就在他思索之际，脑海中再度有系统的声音传出。
“叮，恭喜宿主，新的签到地点已刷新！”
“请在元天至尊秘藏签到！”
“又有新的签到地了？”君逍遥眸光一闪。
他发现了签到系统的一些规则。
第一，可以同时存在多个签到地点。
第二，签到地点，是可以随着事件触发的。
比如他一得知元天至尊秘藏的消息，签到地就刷新了。
“也罢，看来日后不得不去一趟了。”君逍遥心想。
签到机会可是非常难得的，那些未知的奖励也很令人眼馋。
“仗剑族兄，你可真是太见外了……”
君逍遥淡笑着，抬起手一招，那元天至尊令便是抓在了手中。
君仗剑嘴角一抽。
我可能不是人，但你是真的狗。

不过君仗剑在心痛的同时，亦有震惊。
“好雄浑的法力，竟然呈金色，难道真的如传闻中那般，是荒古圣体？”
君仗剑暗自心惊，对君逍遥更加忌惮。
content_en:
Lan Qingya was stunned, completely confused.
She covered her burning side face and looked at Jun Zhanjian in disbelief.
Jun Zhanjian's face was extremely gloomy, and there was a coldness in his eyes.
"Young Master Zhanjian, are you going to hit me?" Lan Qingya said in disbelief.
Feeling the gradually swollen cheeks, Lan Qingya felt as if she was dreaming.
Jun Zhanjian, hasn’t he always been obedient to her?
Lan Qingya even had the feeling that the Jun family sequence was nothing more than this.
Lan Qingya even imagined that she would be able to completely control Jun Zhanjian in the future, and he would do whatever she said.
May I ask which retainer with a foreign surname can control the order of the Jun family?
She Lan Qingya is capable!
But now, looking at Jun Zhanjian's gloomy face, Lan Qingya felt like he had become a stranger.
"Who asked you to provoke Jun Xiaoyao?" Jun Zhanjian's tone suppressed his anger.
"I...I was all thinking about you, Master Zhanjian. You recruited Jun Linglong before, but she ignored her, but in the end she was willing to follow that Jun Xiaoyao..." Lan Qingya was still defending.
"Asshole!"
When Jun Zhanjian heard this, he couldn't help but slap the other half of Lan Qingya's face again.
Lan Qingya was slapped away. The corners of her mouth were broken and she was bleeding.
"Do you know who Jun Xiaoyao is? Do you know who his father is?" Jun Zhanjian was so angry that his liver ached.
Lan Qingya thinks his position is too stable and wants to shake it?
"Isn't it that Jun Wuhui? Now his whereabouts are unknown!" Lan Qingya gritted her silver teeth and looked ugly.
"You have no right to insult Uncle Wuhui!"
Jun slapped his sword and slapped Lan Qingya more than ten times in a row, turning her cheeks into pig heads.
All the followers around him looked astonished.
Is the sun coming out in the west?
"Don't mention that Jun Xiaoyao is the son of Uncle Wuhui. His mother is also the goddess of the Jiang family. He also has the attention of the Eighteenth Ancestor. Do you want me to lose my position in the tenth rank by provoking him?" Jun Zhanjian really wanted to slap Lan Qingya to death.
It was not good to offend anyone, but Jun Xiaoyao, who had the highest status and the largest background in the Jun family, was offended.
"Master Zhanjian, Qingya is wrong, please spare Qingya!"
Lan Qingya knelt down and kowtowed, her chin covered with blood.
She had never thought that Jun Zhanjian would be so afraid of Jun Xiaoyao, and would not even hesitate to attack her.
"Get up and go and apologize to Jun Xiaoyao!" Jun Zhanjian said coldly.
"Young Master Zhanjian, this..." Lan Qingya felt as if she had been struck by lightning.
If this is true, how can she have the honor to stay in Jun's house in the future?
And asking her to bow her head and admit her mistake in front of Jun Linglong was even more uncomfortable than eating shit.
"Huh? Not going?" Jun Zhanjian's eyes were as sharp as a sword.
"I'll go..." Lan Qingya was terrified, with a look of humiliation on her face.
Later, a follower found a bundle of thorns and asked Lan Qingya to carry it.
The sharp thorns on the thorns scratched her jade back, causing Lan Qingya to hiss in pain and suck in cold air.
"Forget it, I'll go with you. This will show your sincerity." Jun Zhanjian hesitated for a moment and decided to go together himself.
Lan Qingya was even more desperate.
This was the first time she saw Jun Zhanjian so uneasy.
So who is Jun Xiaoyao, who can make Jun Zhanjian fearful to this extent?
Jun Zhanjian left Lingdao with Lan Qingya, who was asking for forgiveness, and went to the Emperor's Palace.
Along the way, many Jun family members noticed it.
"That's... the tenth sequence of Jun Zhanjian, is he out of seclusion?"
"Jun Zhanjian's strength has improved again, and he is heading towards the Heavenly Emperor's Palace. Could it be that he is looking for trouble with the Son of God?"
"No, look at Lan Qingya..."
Many eyes fell on Lan Qingya.
She held a thorn to plead guilty, her back was covered with blood, her cheeks were red and swollen, and the corners of her mouth were cracked and bleeding. She looked as embarrassed as she could be.
"Could it be that Jun Zhanjian is not looking for trouble, but... to apologize?"
All the children of the Jun family,They all felt stunned.
The tenth rank of the dignified Jun family actually surrendered?
"Tsk, tsk, I'm afraid only Lord Son of God is qualified to let a person of rank defeat others without fighting." A young man from the Jun family praised.
Which of the top ten sequences is not full of pride?
It is too difficult to defeat someone without fighting.
But Jun Xiaoyao did it.
In the Emperor's Palace, Jun Xiaoyao was relaxing.
Jun Linglong was making tea for Jun Xiaoyao on the side.
The water is made from tens of thousands of years of condensation, and paired with tea leaves picked from the ancient trees of Enlightenment.
This pot of tea, placed in the outside world, some ordinary geniuses would never be able to enjoy it in their lifetime.
Jun Xiaoyao drinks it every day.
"Sir, please..." Jun Linglong handed over the tea, looking like a conscientious maid.
At this time, a servant of the Heavenly Emperor's Palace shouted respectfully at the door: "Master Shenzi, Master Jun Zhanjian has come to the Heavenly Emperor's Palace."
"Is it finally here? I've been waiting for so many days." Jun Xiaoyao's eyes lit up and he became energetic.
Has the royal plot finally begun?
Lan Qingya went back and cried, Jun Zhanjian was furious and decided to come and teach him a lesson.
Jun Xiaoyao just needs someone to test his divine elephant's prison-suppressing power.
Jun Linglong's pretty face was calm. She knew that Jun Zhanjian couldn't do anything to Jun Xiaoyao.
"Haha, brother Xiaoyao, this is the first time we have met since you were born. I didn't expect it to be in this way. It's really a pity."
A hearty voice came, and Jun stepped through the door with his sword, followed by the embarrassed Lan Qingya, her head lowered and a thorn stick on her back.
"Hey, this... isn't right..." Jun Xiaoyao was confused when he saw this.
He felt that Jun Zhanjian didn't play according to the routine.
"My followers provoked the Xiaoyao clan brother, and I specially asked her to come here to plead guilty. I hope that there will be a lot of Xiaoyao clan brothers." Jun Zhanjian said with a faint smile.
Lan Qingya gritted her teeth, feeling extremely humiliated, but still knelt on the ground.
He squeezed out a sentence from the gap in his mouth: "I hope Lord Shenzi and Jun Linglong can forgive Qingya..."
After saying this, Lan Qingya almost wanted to bury her head in the ground.
Jun Linglong's pretty face was cold.
Jun Xiaoyao was also silent.
When Jun Zhanjian saw this, his eyes twitched.
He was really afraid that if Jun Xiaoyao sued the Eighteenth Ancestor, his future in the sequence would be completely ruined.
Gritting his teeth secretly, Jun Zhanjian took out a token and said: "By the way, I was training outside before and accidentally got two Yuantian Supreme Tokens. It is rumored that it may be related to the secret treasure of Yuantian Supreme. I have no use for the extra one, so I gave it to my Xiaoyao clan brother."
"The Supreme Secret!" Jun Linglong's beautiful eyes on the side were also secretly shocked.
Above the holy realm is the supreme realm.
That is an existence that truly stands at the pinnacle of the Immortal Realm, immortal and indestructible, threatening time and space forever!
The value of such a supreme treasure is unimaginable!
If this kind of token is released to the outside world, it will cause a bloody storm, attracting countless geniuses to fight for it to the death!
Jun Zhanjian also spent a lot of effort and paid a lot of money to get two pieces.
Jun Xiaoyao was also surprised. He didn't expect Jun Zhanjian to be willing to take out such a good thing.
Just as he was thinking, a systematic voice came out of his mind again.
"Ding, congratulations to the host, the new check-in location has been refreshed!"
"Please sign in at Yuantian Supreme Secret Treasure!"
"Is there a new check-in place?" Jun Xiaoyao's eyes flashed.
He discovered some rules of the sign-in system.
First, multiple check-in locations can exist at the same time.
Second, the check-in location can be triggered by events.
For example, as soon as he learned about the Yuantian Supreme Secret Treasure, the check-in place was refreshed.
"Well, it seems I have to go there in the future." Jun Xiaoyao thought to himself.
The opportunity to sign in is very rare, and the unknown rewards are also very coveted.
"Brother from the Sword Clan, you are really out of touch..."
Jun Xiaoyao smiled lightly, raised his hand and waved, the Yuantian Supreme Order wasCaught in hand.
Jun Zhanjian's mouth twitched.
I may not be a human, but you are a real dog.
However, while Jun Zhanjian was heartbroken, he was also shocked.
"What a powerful magical power, and it turns out to be golden. Is it really the ancient holy body as rumored?"
Jun Zhanjian was secretly frightened and even more afraid of Jun Xiaoyao.
